description: Software as a Service subscription agreements covering cloud software access and usage

required_clauses.description: Defines subscription tiers, pricing, billing cycle, and fee escalation terms
Defines who owns customer data, how it is used, and what happens to it upon termination
Defines uptime guarantees, performance standards, and remedies for service failures
Defines security standards, breach notification obligations, and compliance requirements like SOC2 or ISO27001
Grants customer a limited non-exclusive license to access and use the software
Defines prohibited uses of the software and consequences for violations
Caps vendor liability — typically limited to fees paid in the prior 12 months
Defines subscription term, auto-renewal conditions, and cancellation notice periods
Defines customer's right to export data and the format and timeline for export
Protects confidential information shared between vendor and customer
Specifies which jurisdiction's law governs the agreement

optional_clauses.description: Data processing addendum for EU personal data
Defines backup and recovery procedures and RTO/RPO
